note: Format facts used by the BJT page and where each comes from. Practice questions are original; none is an official BJT item.

facts.fact: Three parts: Part I Listening Comprehension (approx. 45 min), Part II Listening and Reading Comprehension (approx. 30 min), Part III Reading Comprehension (30 min).
Scores are scaled with Item Response Theory (IRT), not raw totals; there is no pass/fail.
Score bands: J1+ 600–800, J1 530–599, J2 420–529, J3 320–419, J4 200–319, J5 0–199, with official ability descriptions.
CBT format (since April 2017): 80 questions. Part I: 描写/場面把握 5, 表現力/発言聴解 10, 聴解/総合聴解 10 (25). Part II: 状況把握 5, 描写/資料聴読解 10, 聴読解/総合聴読解 10 (25). Part III: 文法語彙 10, 表現力/表現読解 10, 短文読解/総合読解 10 (30).

Section formats: scene photo + spoken statements; utterance: picture + spoken situation + spoken options (keigo, relationships); comprehensive listening: illustration + dialogue/interview; situation: photo + conversation, printed options; document: graph/ad + spoken question; integrated: conversation + schedule/table/form/screen; reading: vocabulary/grammar, expression (register), comprehensive reading of emails/articles/reports.

CBT screens show remaining time and move forward with a Next button; some questions play audio automatically. The pages consulted do not state how many times audio is played or whether earlier questions can be revisited — the app's mock rules (audio plays once by default, forward-only) are a practice setting, not an official rule.
Total sitting time of about two hours including instructions and questionnaire was given in the learner's brief; the pages consulted only state the part times (45 + 30 + 30 min).

levels.en: Able to communicate sufficiently in Japanese in any business situation
Able to communicate appropriately in Japanese in a wide range of business situations
Able to communicate appropriately in Japanese in a limited range of business situations
Able to achieve some degree of communication in Japanese in a limited range of business situations
Able to achieve minimal degree of communication in Japanese in a limited range of business situations
Virtually no ability to communicate in Japanese in business situations
